hypothesis: Request255 can predict one-step ENTER-vs-WAIT direction at pullback states, but that local target does not improve economics. A fixed three-opportunity WAIT option target may better represent the value of preserving future entry choices without selecting a hindsight-best future state.
wait_option_target: mean fixed entry value of the next 1st, 2nd, and 3rd observed states; if the window ends before one of those opportunities, that missing opportunity contributes cash=0; if an existing future state's fixed entry value is unresolved, the target is unresolved
advantage_target: current fixed entry value minus the three-opportunity WAIT option value
model: causal binary classifier for advantage > 0 trained on controller-train states only
policy: After a 2% pullback from the running post-HOT high, ENTER iff P(current entry better than fixed three-opportunity WAIT option) >= 0.5. Otherwise WAIT and reconsider at the next observed state. If the window ends, remain in cash.
forbidden: choosing the best future entry state
tuning the three-state horizon on May11-20
tuning the 2% trigger or 0.5 classifier threshold on May11-20
next_if_pass: Freeze the multi-step wait option gate and audit one-second execution support.
next_if_fail: The recurrent entry problem is not solved by local option-value targets; redesign the post-HOT state representation or move to a richer policy learner before using a new holdout.
